# agents.CustomSkill

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A skill (named markdown instructions) an organization wrote for its agents.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `agents.CustomSkill` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.agent-settings.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the skill was created (UTC). |  |
| `createdBy` | yes | `personal` | Uid of the admin who created it. |  |
| `description` | yes | `none` | When an agent should use the skill; the model routes by it. |  |
| `enabled` | yes | `none` | Whether agents that select the skill get it. |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | Firestore automatic id of the skill. |  |
| `instructions` | yes | `personal` | Markdown instructions the skill gives an agent; written by the organization, so they may mention people. |  |
| `name` | yes | `none` | Kebab-case name, unique in the organization. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Owning organization. |  |
| `updatedAt` | yes | `none` | When the skill last changed (UTC). |  |
